summary.intent: Execute phase 60 (IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout) of the cipher-box GSD workflow using wave-based sequential subagent execution, hardening Rust and TypeScript IPNS record verification to be strictly fail-closed across all layers.
summary.outcome: Completed Wave 1 in full (plans 60-01, 60-02, 60-03) and Wave 2 plan 60-04, reaching 4/8 plans done. Wave 1 gate passed with 251/251 sdk-core tests. Transcript ends with 60-05 spawned but incomplete.

repo: Phase 60 satisfies requirement HARD-11; 8 plans across 4 waves; Wave 4 (60-08) is non-autonomous (staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test — human checkpoint).
The IPNS verify chokepoint was relocated from crates/fuse/src/verify.rs into crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs so sdk/fuse/desktop share one implementation.
All 9 first-publish producers (FUSE, desktop Tauri, sdk-core, web) previously wrote sequence 0; 60-02 unified them to sequence 1.
crates/fuse/src/verify.rs became an empty re-export shell after 60-01 and was fully deleted by 60-04.
sdk-core has 251 tests including 34 ipns-specific tests; this is the Wave 1 integration gate.

code.finding: Was the last VerifyError::Legacy reference; 60-01's executor folded it to Invalid (E0599 in the executor diagnostic was a stale mid-edit snapshot — tree was actually clean).
Had a stale expectation of 0n for first-publish sequence; 60-02's scope change (seq=1) required updating this to 1n.
Executor appended a stray self-check footer after the commit boundary, making it factually wrong after 60-04 deleted verify.rs. Had to be reverted manually.

workflow: GSD worktree isolation (Agent isolation='worktree') cannot reliably expose the resulting branch/path for merge-back — sequential mode on the feature branch is safer for delicate crypto phases.
The GSD commit helper false-negatives with 'No staged files match any configured task' even when the commit lands; always verify with git log rather than trusting the helper status.
Sequential executor subagents must commit Cargo.lock alongside Cargo.toml edits; if a subagent adds crate deps without committing the lockfile, the next wave will have a latent --locked CI break.
Wave scope bleed is a real risk: 60-01 had to fold all VerifyError::Legacy FUSE caller arms as a compile necessity, encroaching on 60-04's declared scope — but the end state was correct.

friction: 60-01 executor removed VerifyError::Legacy and folded all 9 FUSE caller arms (nominally 60-04 scope) as a compile necessity — blurred wave boundary required manual audit.
E0599 compile error in executor output was a stale mid-edit diagnostic, requiring an extra cargo check round-trip to confirm the tree was actually green.
60-01 executor added ciborium + cipherbox-core deps to Cargo.toml but never committed Cargo.lock, creating a latent --locked CI break discovered only mid-Wave-2.
GSD commit helper reported commit_failed for the Cargo.lock cleanup commit but the commit had actually landed — required git log verification to disambiguate.
